project.name: ScopeGuard
project.summary: A small web app that records client change requests and produces an approval link before extra work begins.

product_vision.statement: Help small web agencies prevent unpaid scope creep by documenting and approving change requests.

source_refs.excerpt: I want the client to approve extra work before we start.

actors.statement: Agency team member who creates and tracks change requests.
Client contact who reviews and approves or rejects a change request through a secure link.

goals.statement: Record scope, price and schedule impact before additional work starts.

out_of_scope.statement: V0 will not process payments or replace the agency's invoicing system.

user_flows.statement: Agency creates a change request and sends an approval link to the client.
steps: Agency creates a request with description, price and schedule impact.
System creates a secure single-request link.
Client approves or rejects and may add a comment.
Agency sees the immutable decision record.
failure_paths: Expired or invalid link shows a clear error and asks the agency to issue a new link.

requirements.statement: An agency user can create a change request containing description, price impact and schedule impact.
A client can approve or reject exactly one change request through a secure link without creating an account.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given an authenticated agency user, when all required fields are valid, saving creates a draft request and displays its identifier.
Given a valid unexpired approval link, when the client selects approve, the request becomes approved with timestamp and optional comment and cannot be approved a second time.
Given an invalid or expired link, the system reveals no request details and displays an instruction to contact the agency for a new link.

data_entities.statement: Change request with agency ownership, client-facing token, description, price impact, schedule impact, status and decision metadata.

permission_rules.statement: Agency accounts can access only change requests belonging to their own agency workspace.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Client approval tokens must be unguessable, stored safely and revocable by the agency.

decisions.statement: Client approval in V0 does not require a client account.

risks.statement: Forwarded approval links could allow the wrong person to act; V0 mitigates with revocation, expiry and clear agency responsibility.

solution_blueprint.recommended_option: Responsive web application with server-side API, relational database and token-based client approval route.
constraints: Client link reveals no data when invalid or expired
delegated_to_xdev: Framework selection within supported web stack

hard_gates.details: All P0/P1 requirements have acceptance criteria.
M8 independent audit has not been executed for this M7 sample.
